semantics.identity_validation: all source identities positive, bounded and unique across the complete snapshot
semantics.selectable: source category and name-length eligibility only; never country approval, activation or verified address suitability
semantics.population: source population estimate; zero can mean unknown and is not evidence of an uninhabited place
semantics.parent_rule: same-country explicit ADM hierarchy with decreasing source rank, otherwise labelled same-source admin-code join or country-only fallback
semantics.names: GeoNames primary and ASCII names plus up to64 untagged alternate names; no native-language or official-name claim
semantics.ordering: pinned source snapshot order; stable geonameId identities do not depend on order
semantics.timezone: source centroid candidate, not timezone boundary proof or an automatic branch default
semantics.readiness: reference candidates only; no country activation, current graph replacement or national postal completeness claim
semantics.coverage_limit: all available A/P features, including rural/zero-population places; GeoNames itself does not warrant exhaustive or current national coverage
